+{"loc":"ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p320","rows":[{"verses":["62:6"],"words":["*"],"type":"links","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Al-Ḥashr portrays Banū Qurayẓah and their allies as so fearful that they will not fight openly and fear the Muslims more than God.","anchor":"In Sūrah al-Ḥashr, the cowardliness of the Banū Qurayẓah and their allies is portrayed in the following words:","mentions":["59:13","59:14"]},{"verses":["62:6"],"words":["*"],"type":"links","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Al-Baqarah develops the same challenge: the Jews will not wish for death because of their misdeeds and instead are exceptionally greedy for life.","anchor":"In Sūrah al-Baqarah, this subject is discussed thus in relatively more detail:","mentions":["2:94","2:95","2:96"]},{"verses":["62:6"],"words":["*"],"type":"referent","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Although “others” is general, it particularly means the Ishmaelites, toward whom Jewish hostility arose from Torah predictions and racial jealousy and intensified when Muḥammad appeared.","anchor":"Because of the predictions of the Torah and because of racial jealousy, the Jews had special enmity with them.","mentions":[]},{"verses":["62:6"],"words":["*"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The Jews stayed silent because the challenge struck a sore point that their past and present conduct confirmed.","anchor":"They felt that the Qur’ān had caught hold of a sore issue, and so they sought refuge in silence.","mentions":[]},{"verses":["62:7"],"words":["*"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Their misdeeds are the reason they are too cowardly to wish for death.","anchor":"Mentioned in this verse is the reason of their cowardice; what has made them so","mentions":[]}]}
